item_short_desc: Rothco’s Special Forces Hat is made from a durable 100% brushed cotton twill and features an embroidered Special Forces insignia as well as the text “Special Forces” on the front panel. This military hat also features a hook and loop closure in back for adjustability and a padded sweatband for added comfort.
